description: a calm young man with short fair hair in layered white and gold vestments down to the ankles, a golden sash, brown boots, a book at the belt, a staff topped with a small golden sun held upright and leaning back over the shoulder, no halo, nothing on the back, sitting astride and riding in the pose of the grey mannequin, both hands in front holding the reins, seen from the side, facing right, only the near leg showing, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the foot inside the image, nothing under the rider, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what is carried
the pose, size and place of the figure: sitting astride a saddle that is not drawn, seen from the side, facing right, both hands in front holding the reins, only the near leg showing; copy it exactly
